# ShreeSwarupOS

> ShreeSwarupOS is a comprehensive, cloud-based restaurant operating system that unifies contactless QR digital menus, POS order billing, Kitchen Order Ticketing (KOT), staff management, table reservations, and live analytics.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/): Official overview of ShreeSwarupOS features, benefits, and digital restaurant transformation.
- [Features](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/features): Complete breakdown of POS billing, QR digital ordering, kitchen display systems, inventory tracking, and waiter apps.
- [Pricing Plans](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/pricing): Standard subscription tiers, feature comparison, and plan details for single and multi-branch restaurants.
- [About Us](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/about-us): Mission, vision, and technology stack behind ShreeSwarupOS.
- [Tutorials & Guides](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials): Step-by-step guides and video tutorials for setting up and operating restaurant workflows.

## Guides & Tutorials
- [Dashboard Setup Guide](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/dashboard-setup): How to initialize and configure your restaurant dashboard.
- [POS Order Processing](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-place-order-via-pos): Creating dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders from the POS terminal.
- [KOT Kitchen Management](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-manage-kot-kitchen-orders): Managing real-time kitchen orders and chef displays.
- [Table & QR Code Generation](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-add-tables-generate-qr-codes): Adding dining areas, tables, and downloading high-resolution QR codes.
- [Menu Categories & Items](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-add-menu-items): Adding dishes, variations, prices, images, and item categories.
- [Modifier Groups](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-add-modifier-groups): Creating add-ons, toppings, and dish customization options.
- [Table Reservations](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-manage-table-reservations): Accepting online customer table reservations and slot management.
- [Staff & Waiter Management](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-manage-staff-waiters): Setting up waiter accounts, assigning table sections, and permissions.
- [Sales & Tax Reports](https://shreeswaruposweb.vrsonisoft.com/tutorials/how-to-export-sales-reports): Exporting revenue reports, itemized breakdown, and tax summaries.
